description:
Create a Sentry Alert (notification workflow) that sends Slack, email, PagerDuty, or other notifications when its connected issue streams or monitors trigger.
get_alert_options lists valid actions, conditions, and sources; update_alert_rule adds sources to an existing Alert.
Monitors are separate tools: find_metric_monitors (metric thresholds), find_monitors (cron jobs), find_uptime_monitors (URL checks).
After a timeout or error, search for the Alert before retrying: it may already exist.

actionFilters.description: Action groups with conditions and notification actions, from get_alert_options or copied from get_alert_rule. Component IDs are dropped; integration and destination IDs are kept. Pass [] for none.

config.description: Provider config. Slack and Teams: set targetDisplay to the channel name in the integrationId workspace; Sentry resolves the ID. Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email: set targetIdentifier; a new display name alone keeps the old target.

detectorIds.description: Monitor source IDs from get_alert_options. Pass [] for an Alert with no sources; it sends nothing until connected. An all-project source also needs org:write.

environment.description: Environment the Alert applies to. Null means all environments.

frequencyMinutes.description: Minimum interval between notifications, in minutes.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

owner.description: Owner as user:<id> or team:<id>. Null clears it.

projectSlugs.description: Projects whose issue streams to connect. Set this, detector IDs, or both.

items.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.
Trigger conditions, in the shape get_alert_rule returns; copied IDs are dropped. Null or an empty group means no triggers.

name: create_alert_rule

anyOf.description: Complete list of action groups with their conditions and notification actions, copied from get_alert_rule. Keep IDs and unchanged entries; omitted groups, conditions, and actions are removed.

config.description: Provider config. Slack and Teams: set targetDisplay to the channel name in the integrationId workspace; Sentry resolves the ID. Discord, PagerDuty, Opsgenie, email: set targetIdentifier; a new display name alone keeps the old target.

anyOf.description: Complete trigger group, copied from get_alert_rule. Keep existing condition IDs; omitted conditions are removed.

title: Create Alert Rule
